messages:
Ravi: Quick question for the group: can we standardize an automated deletion + audit-event flow for ad-hoc SIEM exports? Thinking: tag export with export-id, kick off TTL job, emit audit event when deleted.
Nina: Yes please. Right now a lot of adhoc exports sit forever in buckets.
Eve: Agree. We should also enforce that every export has a linked ticket id and a named consumer service-account.
Sam: From RBAC side: any change that grants a consumer SA read access to production logs must go through ACL PR + security approval.
audit-bot: Policy reminder: SEC-LOG-09 mandates immutable audit trail for exports (who requested, who approved, key unwrap events).
Ravi: Proposal outline: 1) export metadata JSON (export-id, ticket, consumer-sa, fields, retention-ttl) stored alongside artifact; 2) background cleaner reads TTL and deletes; 3) deletion emits audit-log and attaches deletion-snapshot id.
Nina: Implementation notes: store metadata in same bucket but encrypted with export-specific envelope (KMS key + wrapped DEK). Cleaner runs in infra account with unwrap-permission only for cleaner.
Eve: KMS approach ok but prefer using key-proxy to mint ephemeral unwrap tokens for cleaner, TTL 30m. Avoid giving long-term unwrap perms to processes.
Sam: How do we handle emergency extensions? Ops may need extra time during incident. We need an explicit extension workflow that requires pager + security approval.
Ravi: Draft extension workflow: request in ticket, provide justification, tag oncall, security approves in ticket, system bumps TTL and records audit event. No manual bucket fiddling.
Nina: For data minimization, we should support pre-export transforms: field-redact rules and hashing. Make transforms declarative and stored in export metadata.
Eve: Also add a delivery contract: only allow SIEM remote ingest OR presigned URL into a dedicated secure bucket with bucket-level encryption + ACL limited to consumer SA. No open URLs.
Sam: Retention defaults? I'm leaning: 7 days default, 14 days for multi-team troubleshooting, 30 days only with legal/customer justification.
audit-bot: Enforcement: system will reject retention >14d unless ticket has security approval tag.
Ravi: Nice. CLI snippets for key-proxy and create-export: `exportctl create --ticket=ENG-1234 --consumer=svc-searcheval --streams=api-requests --start=2026-03-05T00:00Z --end=2026-03-05T06:00Z --retain=7d --redact=ip,username`
Nina: Good idea to have tool that validates minimization rules and warns about sensitive fields. It should refuse if principal_identifiers are selected without justification.
Eve: For RBAC review, include a short checklist: confirm consumer SA least-priv, ACL PR link, KMS handling documented, delivery destination secure, retention + deletion ticket created, extension policy understood.
Sam: Last bit: make sure deletion emits an event to the security-sink so SIEM can index export lifecycle events for future audit.
Ravi: I'll wire up a prototype of exportctl and post a docs PR. Thanks all.
__note: Slack thread: engineering discussion about automating SIEM export metadata, TTL deletion, KMS key-proxy usage, RBAC PRs, and extension workflow.
